name: Cyclonian

angles.text: As a warrior, defeating Cyclonian tests your strength and martial mastery. Claim his whirlwind heart and use it to forge a potent weapon.

faq.answer: Cyclonian is a powerful elemental wind lord and a grave threat. Observers have watched him for ages, waiting for a champion strong enough to challenge and defeat him.
Cyclonian is summoned so a worthy champion can challenge and slay him. The victor can claim his whirlwind heart and have its power infused into a formidable weapon.
The Whirlwind Heart is Cyclonian's core essence. Torn from the defeated wind lord, its tempestuous energies can be infused into a weapon of great martial power.
Bath'rah the Windwatcher in the Alterac Mountains has kept vigil over the site for ages. He searches endlessly for a true champion who can topple Cyclonian and master his tempestuous heart.
A special parchment records the rare reagents needed to summon Cyclonian and draw the wind lord into the world to be challenged.
The champion who gathers the necessary components, summons Cyclonian, and slays him earns a weapon infused with the latent fury of the elemental's whirlwind heart.
faq.q: What weapon is forged from Cyclonian?

sections.body: A watcher has kept vigil at the summoning site for ages. The raging elemental wind lord awaits a combatant with the raw martial prowess to challenge and destroy him.
sections.title: The Slumbering Wind Lord

sections.body: A special parchment names the rare materials needed to summon Cyclonian. Once the wind lord is called forth, you face him in direct combat. You may defeat him, or fall to his howling gale.
sections.title: Summoning the Tempest

sections.body: Cyclonian's whirlwind heart is sought from the defeated elemental. Severed from him, its fierce elemental energies can be bound and infused into a weapon fit for an accomplished champion.
sections.title: The Whirlwind Heart

summary: At the summoning site, Cyclonian waits for a champion bold enough to face him. A special parchment names the rare materials needed to call forth the wind lord, whose whirlwind heart can strengthen a formidable weapon.
